source: client brief — XF-505 green polyimide PCB color-coding & high-temperature traceability

title.en: Color-Coded PCB Identification | XF-505 Green Polyimide Label
title.zh: PCB 彩色分类与高温追溯 | XF-505 绿色聚酰亚胺标签

subtitle.en: A 1 mil light-green polyimide label with permanent acrylic adhesive — color coding that survives reflow, cleaning and process chemicals.
subtitle.zh: 1 mil 浅绿色聚酰亚胺标签，永久丙烯酸压敏胶 —— 绿色分类，耐回流焊、清洗与制程化学品。

seo_desc.en: XF-505 pairs a 1 mil light-green polyimide film with a permanent acrylic PSA for PCB color classification that stays legible and firmly bonded through reflow, wave soldering, flux, IPA and cleaning.
seo_desc.zh: XF-505 采用 1 mil 浅绿色聚酰亚胺薄膜与永久丙烯酸压敏胶，用于 PCB 彩色分类，在回流焊、波峰焊、助焊剂、IPA 与清洗后仍清晰牢固。

zh.label: 面材
zh.value: 1 mil（25 μm）浅绿色聚酰亚胺薄膜

zh.label: 适用制程
zh.value: 回流焊、波峰焊、喷淋/擦拭清洗

en: In PCB production, models, batches and process/inspection status are often distinguished by color. Ordinary colored labels discolor, curl or lift after reflow soldering, cleaning and chemicals — losing identification and traceability.
zh: PCB 生产中常以颜色区分型号、批次与工艺/检验状态。普通彩色标签经回流焊、清洗及化学处理后易变色、翘边或脱落，丢失识别与追溯。

en: Long-term adhesion through to final use
zh: 从生产到成品的长期粘接

en: XF-505 combines a 1 mil light-green polyimide film with permanent acrylic adhesive — visual color coding plus reliable identification through high-temperature processing.
zh: XF-505 采用 1 mil 浅绿色聚酰亚胺薄膜与永久丙烯酸压敏胶 —— 绿色目视管理，兼顾高温制程下的稳定识别。

en.label: Color classification
en.text: Light-green facestock distinguishes models, batches, process routes and inspection status at a glance — fewer mix-ups.

en.label: High-temperature compatible
en.text: Polyimide film stays stable through reflow and wave soldering — less shrinkage, lifting or detachment.

en.label: Reliable adhesion
en.text: Permanent acrylic adhesive bonds firmly to common PCB surfaces for the long term.

en.label: Clear thermal-transfer print
en.text: Prints crisp barcodes, QR, SN and batch codes and stays scannable after processing.

en.label: Chemical resistant
en.text: Withstands flux, IPA and common PCB cleaning without blurring or lifting.

zh.label: 颜色分类
zh.text: 浅绿色面材一眼区分型号、批次、工艺路线与检验状态，减少混料误判。

zh.label: 适应高温制程
zh.text: 聚酰亚胺面材在回流焊、波峰焊下保持稳定，降低收缩、起翘与脱落。

zh.label: 稳定粘接
zh.text: 永久丙烯酸压敏胶牢固贴合常见 PCB 表面，长期保持稳定。

zh.label: 清晰热转印
zh.text: 清晰打印条码、二维码、SN 码与批次信息，制程后仍可扫码。

zh.label: 耐制程化学品
zh.text: 耐助焊剂、IPA 及常见 PCB 清洗，不晕墨、不脱落。

en: Serial number, barcode and QR-code traceability
zh: SN 码、条码及二维码追溯
